items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He lived where I lived for a while, at 25 Fifth Avenue, but we never met.

ctx.x: . . . even maybe by John Hammond. As we start to talk about Hammond, Marshall Stearns, Roger Pryor Dodge, George Frazier, and all those people who you knew, I’m curious about – let’s start with Hammond and make our intersection Hammond and Newton.
That is news to me, because John Hammond wrote for The New Masses, and although he was the scion of a wealthy family, was pretty left himself.
